The convergence of internal textual evidence - including theological sophistication, community tensions, and gospel relationships - suggests the letter originated during the period when early Christian communities were establishing distinct theological positions and writing extensive doctrinal literature.

Both claims originate from legitimate academic sources, though they reach different conclusions through similar methodological approaches.

CONCLUSION
Given the overlapping nature of the estimates and the fact that both ranges represent scholarly consensus rather than absolute certainty, the evidence better supports the 85-95 CE range as the more likely timeframe, though the dating remains inherently uncertain.
